_note: 삼촌 표정 영상 (2026-11-11 BK): HeyGen으로 한 번만 만들어 media/uncle/<이름>.mp4 로 두고 영상마다 골라 섞어 쓴다. 목소리는 7번(Supertonic M2). 이름 앞부분(intro/react/outro)이 쓰임새.

intro-excited.motion: Excited and cheerful, leans slightly toward the camera with a big smile and raised eyebrows.

intro-curious.motion: Curious friendly look, tilts head slightly and gestures toward the viewer.

react-surprised.motion: Genuinely surprised, eyes widen and eyebrows go up, slight lean back.

react-laugh.motion: Warm hearty laugh, nods while smiling broadly.

react-think.motion: Thoughtful, slightly frowns and raises one finger as a gentle warning.

react-nod.motion: Calm confident nod with a satisfied smile.

outro-1.say: 광고 링크라 삼촌한테 수수료가 조금 와. 비교는 돈 줍는 삼촌 닷컴에서!
outro-1.motion: Friendly and honest, small shrug then a warm smile and a light wave.

outro-2.say: 링크는 광고라 삼촌한테 수수료가 조금 와. 계산은 돈 줍는 삼촌 닷컴에서 해 봐!
outro-2.motion: Relaxed smile, points down toward the screen bottom, then a thumbs-up.
